actions.reason: C0005 shows strong biological support with significant RNA pathway enrichment (interferon/inflammatory) and significant BAP1 mutation enrichment (q=0.0044), despite a site confounder (CJ) which is interpreted alongside biology. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with support from CT, WSI, and RNA, and the set is not an echo of stage/grade.

C0001 has strong RNA pathway signal but no significant WXS or CNV support, and cross-modal consistency is weak (near-zero silhouettes in CT, WSI, genomic; low internal structure). The biological signal is not corroborated across modalities, and no extra evidence is available.

C0002 has RNA and CNV support but no significant WXS findings, and cross-modal consistency is weak (CT and genomic silhouettes near zero, low fused boundaries). The set is not consistently supported across modalities, and technical confounders (site, manufacturer) approach significance.

C0003 has no significant biological support in any modality (RNA, WXS, CNV all q>0.05) and is heavily confounded by CT manufacturer/scanner/kernel (FDR-significant). Cross-modal consistency is driven almost entirely by CT, with poor molecular corroboration. The set likely reflects technical artifacts.

C0004 has no significant biological support in any modality (RNA, WXS, CNV all q>0.05) and weak cross-modal consistency (near-zero silhouettes, high PAC). No strong molecular or structural evidence supports a distinct subtype.
